mutants.name: reverse-operations
mutants.replacement: import {geometry} from './geometry.mjs';export function transform(image,operations){let size={width:image.width,height:image.height};for(const op of [...operations].reverse())size=geometry(size,op);return {...image,...size};}

mutants.name: upscale-fit
mutants.replacement: export function geometry(size,op){let {width,height}=size;if(op.type==='rotate'){if(op.turns%2)[width,height]=[height,width];}else if(op.type==='crop'){if(op.x+op.width>width||op.y+op.height>height)throw new RangeError('crop bounds');width=op.width;height=op.height;}else if(op.type==='fit'){const scale=Math.min(op.width/width,op.height/height);width=Math.max(1,Math.floor(width*scale));height=Math.max(1,Math.floor(height*scale));}return {width,height};}
